items.title: Mercedes-Benz launches limited-run Night Edition GLE, GLS SUVs in India
items.summary: Prices for the Night Edition GLS 450 and GLS 450d have been set at ₹1.41 crore and ₹1.43 crore respectively, while the GLE 300d and GLE 450 Night Editions are priced at ₹1.05 crore and ₹1.14 crore, respectively.

items.title: BMW launches nationwide summer service campaign with free vehicle checks
items.summary: BMW Group India has launched its Summer Service Campaign 2026 across dealerships nationwide, offering complimentary vehicle checks, discounts on AC-related services, and preventive maintenance support to enhance customer convenience during peak summer months.

items.title: Mini India ties up with Titanium Autos to expand its retail network in Ranchi
items.summary: Titanium Autos now represents BMW, Mini and BMW Motorrad in Jharkhand. The move adds Ranchi to MINI India’s recent network expansion into Guwahati, Jaipur, Jodhpur and Surat as the company widens its retail footprint beyond major metropolitan centres.

items.title: Honda bets on 10+ models, a local EV, and a hybrid blitz in its India comeback story
items.summary: Japanese automaker plans broad India reset with sub-4m SUVs, hybrids, EVs and premium imports as it seeks to regain relevance in a rapidly changing PV market.

items.title: VinFast unveils upgraded VF 8 electric SUV with new chassis, SDV architecture
items.summary: The upgraded VF 8 electric SUV in Vietnam has been launched at a starting price of VND 999 million, featuring SDV architecture and a claimed 500 km range.

items.title: Bosch Ltd Q4 Revenue Rises 13.3%; FY26 PAT at Rs 2,770 Crore
items.summary: Bosch Limited reported a 13.3% year-on-year increase in revenue from operations for the fourth quarter of FY26 at Rs 5,566 crore, driven by higher demand across the automotive market, including two-wheelers. Profit before tax before exceptional items rose 3.8% year-on-year to Rs 808 crore during the January-March quarter, while profit after tax stood at Rs 568 crore.

items.title: Remsons Industries UK Subsidiary Secures Rs 30 Crore International Supply Contract
items.summary: Remsons Industries Limited announced that its step down subsidiary in the United Kingdom has secured a new international supply contract valued at approximately Rs 30 crore. Remsons Automotive Limited received the formal nomination from a global commercial vehicle original equipment manufacturer.

items.title: Atul Auto, Exponent Energy partner to roll out 15-minute charging electric three-wheelers
items.summary: The tie-up will integrate 15-minute rapid charging technology into factory-built vehicles, aiming to accelerate EV adoption in the commercial segment.

items.title: EVs to drive ₹3.5 lakh crore capex in India's PV sector: Report
items.summary: India Ratings and Research said the top five original equipment manufacturers (OEMs) are expected to account for over ₹2 lakh crore of the planned investments.

items.title: IIT Roorkee Partners With Cathion Energy to Commercialise Lithium Ion Battery Technologies
items.summary: The Indian Institute of Technology (IIT) Roorkee has signed two technology transfer agreements with Cathion Energy Private Limited to commercialise advanced lithium ion battery components. The agreements, finalised on May 22, cover the transfer of novel composite electrode technologies developed by Professor Anjan Sil.

items.title: Auto demand healthy despite rise in input costs: Nirmal Minda
items.summary: He also expressed optimism about the electric vehicle transition, while cautioning that charging infrastructure remained a major bottleneck, particularly outside metros. EV adoption in the two-wheeler segment is progressing faster because home charging is easier to manage.

items.title: Uno Minda bets on FY27 as ‘defining year of execution’ amid expansion push
items.summary: Sunil Bohra, Group Chief Financial Officer, says Uno Minda expects strong growth from its ₹1,200 crore EV capex plan, with revenues projected to cross ₹2,500 crore.

items.title: Germany's ZF to keep electric motor production in-house but with fewer staff
items.summary: After investing heavily ​in new technologies, European carmakers and suppliers have ​faced a slower-than-expected uptake of electric vehicles, although demand is now ​picking up.

items.title: Honda launches facelifted City at ₹11.99 lakh, debuts ZR-V hybrid as new flagship SUV
items.summary: The new City features refreshed styling, new technology features and both petrol and strong hybrid powertrain options, while the ZR-V is powered by Honda’s 2.0-litre e:HEV strong hybrid system.

items.title: Volvo Cars faces Thai legal threat after fresh EX30 fires
items.summary: This adds pressure as the automaker faces a global recall for over 40,000 vehicles due to overheating battery modules. Customers are frustrated by delays in replacement parts, with some facing lengthy waits for repairs.

items.title: Reliance in talks with CATL, global suppliers for battery storage parts for Jamnagar project: Report
items.summary: Reliance’s push to diversify sourcing comes as it faces challenges in fully accessing advanced lithium-ion battery cell manufacturing technology, prompting it to focus more on assembling pre-made battery cells into larger storage systems.

items.title: NGK To Invest ₹4,200 Crore In New Ishikawa Plant For Semiconductor Ceramics
items.summary: NGK Corporation has announced plans to establish a new production facility for ceramics used in semiconductor manufacturing equipment in Nomi City, Ishikawa Prefecture, Japan. The company will invest approximately ₹4,200 crore (¥70 billion) in the project, with mass production expected to begin in October 2029.

items.title: Bosch’s India Recast
items.summary: On May 21, 2026, the German engineering giant Bosch Ltd announced a 50:50 joint venture with the TSF Group’s Brakes India and Wheels India. While the deal might appear to be a localized expansion of air systems for commercial vehicles (CVs), it serves as a microcosm for a much larger, more aggressive transformation as the automotive industry in India is set to evolve rapidly by 2030 and beyond.

items.title: Tesla to establish sales and service centre in Hyderabad
items.summary: The minister congratulated Tesla India General Manager Sharad Agarwal and Lead Public Policy and Business Development Director Rajat for choosing Hyderabad as the next destination for Tesla's sales and service expansion in India.

items.title: Fiem Industries CEO Vineet Sahni Steps Down
items.summary: Fiem Industries Limited announced on May 19 that Vineet Sahni has resigned from his position as Chief Executive Officer and Whole time Director of the company. The automotive lighting and component manufacturer confirmed the leadership change through a regulatory filing submitted to the stock exchanges.

items.title: India’s New Safety Mandates: Driving OEMs to Rethink ADAS Integration
items.summary: India's automotive sector stands at a decisive regulatory inflection point. The Ministry of Road Transport and Highways has mandated a new suite of active safety technologies governed by specific Automotive Industry Standards: AIS 184 for Driver Drowsiness and Attention Warning, AIS 186 and AIS 187 for Blind Spot Detection and Moving-Off Vulnerable Road User Detection, AIS 188 for Lane Departure Warning, and AIS 1...

items.title: Govt extends bid deadline for ₹7,280 crore rare earth magnet manufacturing scheme
items.summary: Under the revised schedule, the bid due date has been extended to June 29, 2026, from the earlier deadline of May 28, while the opening of technical bids has been pushed to June 30 from May 29, 2026.
